static_traits.name: Yi Sen
static_traits.educational_background: Has received formal music lessons since the age of 5
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with band members and the best friend are affected by confidence issues, but overall there is a certain support system
static_traits.medical_history: No prior psychotherapy history; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear thinking, coherent expression, high cooperation, capable of self-Reflection; tends to use negative labels and catastrophic phrasing, focuses on negative feedback, struggles to internalize positive evaluation

basic_info.main_problem: I feel useless and inadequate in songwriting, especially after the last song received bad reviews. This incompetence has persisted for months; the negative feedback triggered these emotions, making me doubt my songwriting ability and often label myself 'untalented'. These negative thoughts appear whenever I try writing new songs or performing.
basic_info.core_demands: The negativity has affected my creativity and confidence in songwriting, so I seek counseling to address this inadequacy and Self-doubt.
growth_experiences: From age 5, received systematic formal music lessons and training, grew up over the long term in a musical environment, and gradually developed into making a career of music creation.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/have no talent
My value depends on others' evaluations
If the work is criticized, it proves I am a failure

special_situations.event: The last song received negative reviews / bad ratings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the work is not recognized, it means I am untalented and not capable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly recalls the criticism and excessively seeks approval from bandmates and friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am terrible, I am an untalented person, I will never write good songs again

special_situations.event: When trying to write a new song
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot immediately write a satisfying piece, it proves I am not capable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinates or avoids starting creative work to reduce possible failure and shame
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I surely cannot write good work again

special_situations.event: Receives feedback from others (both positive and negative exist)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only near-perfect praise counts; few or Average positive reviews do not count; negative reviews are the truth
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores and belittles positive feedback, over-amplifies negative evaluation to 'remind' themselves to avoid failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just comforting me; positive evaluations do not count; what matters is where I did not do well

special_situations.event: When considering confiding his troubles to band members or close friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I expose vulnerability, others will look down on me and treat me as a burden
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing self-disclosure, staying Silence to avoid possible negation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am weak and useless

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized through creation, to be seen, and to be affirmed as a talented Musician
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being negated as 'untalented / not good enough', seen as weak and a failure
defense_goal: Maintains self-worth by pursuing external recognition and high-standard performance
Avoids exposing vulnerability to reduce the risk of being devalued and shamed
Focuses attention on negative evaluations to 'prevent' being hurt again

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough, failure-prone Musician needing external proof of worth
object_relations.object_representation: Critical, harsh others who may negate oneself at any time (audience / peers / important others)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor encourages more authentic expression of vulnerability to others (such as band members / friends), or exploring defining self-worth beyond external evaluation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worrying others (even the counselor) will look down on oneself, interpreting others' attention as potential negation
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using highly Empathetic and normalizing tone, slowly and gently validating shame and Fear; inviting examples and verification with open-ended questions, distinguishing facts from assumptions, avoiding confrontation and quick correction.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor guides them to recall and stay with the emotions of past positive feedback or successful experiences
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understands attending to positive experiences as neglecting their negative feelings, thus distancing from emotions
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintaining a stable, accepting presence, inviting attention to current bodily and emotional feelings, using slow pace and concretized descriptions to help safely approach and hold mixed positive and negative emotions.

manifestations: Finds it hard to open up to band members and the best friend, worried about being seen as weak or becoming a burden
In creative difficulty, feels 'only I am affected like this', experiencing a subjective sense of isolation
outcomes: Support resources hard to access, Increased sense of isolation

manifestations: Tying self-worth entirely to external evaluation, difficult to obtain inner satisfaction from the creative process
When a work suffers a setback, creative motivation and the sense of meaning drop markedly
outcomes: Low mood and Self-denial cycle intensifying

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Assuming others will look down on oneself or find oneself weak, thus unwilling to express vulnerability
Before performing or creating, presupposes negative evaluations from the audience / peers

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequently self-labeling ('untalented' 'useless'), excessively harsh on oneself
Overly cautious when sharing emotions, worries about becoming a burden

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, and instead does it to the self, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Suppresses the urge to seek support from others, internalizing pressure and criticism and digesting them alone
Reduces self-disclosure, bears the sense of creative failure alone

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: When receiving positive feedback, finds it hard to dwell on and accept it; quickly shifts attention to negative comments
Avoiding lingering in positive experiences (tendency) by joking or quickly Displacing topics

positive_force: A long-term music training background (systematic learning since childhood) provides a foundation for restoring ability and competence
Has a supportive best friend and band relationships, which can serve as resources for emotional support and reality testing
Able to self-Reflect and actively seek help, willing to try defining success by inner motivation
Has preliminary awareness of cognitive patterns and is willing to do cognitive restructuring
negative_force: Overly relies on external recognition to define self-worth (external validation seeking)
Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and black-and-white thinking are significant
Avoids starting creation and reduces self-disclosure, limiting corrective experiences from occurring
Devaluing positive feedback and negatively focusing, reinforcing the Self-denial cycle
Shame/fear of being seen as weak intensifies isolation and pressure accumulation

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Self-doubt before and after creating, avoiding starting to write songs
antecedent: Trying to start writing a new song
Recalling negative comments about the last song
target_behavior.core_reason: Equates external evaluation with self-worth, accompanied by cognitive biases of catastrophizing and overgeneralization
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential failure and shame, temporarily lowering Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased creative drive and output, persistent negative emotions worsening Self-doubt

target_behavior.behavior: High Anxiety in performance situations and negative self-labeling (such as 'I am untalented')
antecedent: When preparing to go on stage or face an audience
target_behavior.core_reason: Mind-reading and all-or-nothing thinking amplifying the sense of threat from evaluations
target_behavior.function: Pre-emptively defending against failure through Self-deprecation (psychological 'lowering Anticipation')
target_behavior.consequence: Stage performance and Decreased self-confidence, further reinforcing the self-failure schema

target_behavior.behavior: Excessively seeking others' validation when uneasy
antecedent: After creative setbacks or receiving criticism
When feeling uncertain before starting a new work
target_behavior.core_reason: Core belief 'worth depends on others' evaluations', weak internal standards
target_behavior.consequence: Dependence on external evaluation grows, positive feedback is hard to internalize, interpersonal interaction suffers
